what_happened: After Isa restarts, a leader whose browser is still signed in sees 'Signed in as Watanabe-san' and a Sign out button on the page, but the chat says 'Please sign in so I can help. The Sign in button is at the top of the home page.' There is no Sign in button to press. Cause: KeycloakSignInService keeps sign-in tokens in memory (_sessions), while the sign-in cookie lasts 8 hours (Program.cs AddCookie, sliding), so a restart loses the token but not the cookie. Found on the local setup after several Isa restarts. Also: clicking the header's Sign out button once did not sign out (submitting the form did); to recheck in the keyboard test. Risk for the presentation if Isa is restarted on the demo machine while the browser stays signed in.
fix: Fixed November 10 (Program.cs cookie OnValidatePrincipal; KeycloakSignInService.IsKnownSession): each time a page loads, if Isa no longer holds the session the cookie names, the cookie is turned away and removed, so the page shows Sign in. Checked in the browser: signed in as k.watanabe, reloaded (still signed in), restarted Isa, reloaded: the page shows the Sign in link and no 'Signed in as'. Build: 0 warnings, 0 errors. Smoke set through run_questions.py: the same four paths as before. The header's Sign out button signed out on one click (tried once; keyboard test still to do). After a restart a leader still has to sign in again; add 'sign in again after any restart' to the rehearsal checklist.
